name: Ajna ERC20Pool liquidation accounting campaign
summary: Two Ajna ERC20Pool master lineages permitted a campaign-controlled borrower to compose drawDebt/addQuoteToken/kick with bucketTake/removeCollateral/take/settle/repay so that liquidation accounting released scarce quote assets without matching debt repayment. The violated invariant is that collateral or quote released during an auction must remain covered by repaid debt or equivalent scarce consideration. Eleven immutable pool clones were affected in one coordinated campaign. The legacy and newer masters have different runtimes but implement the same failure; the legacy lineage first reached in the campaign supplies its canonical curve knot while the later newer-lineage recurrence remains reviewed supporting evidence.
notes: The 182-byte immutable pool proxy binds legacy master 0x05bb4f6362b02f17c1a3f2b047a8b23368269a21 and its token pair in runtime arguments and has no mutable implementation slot. The clone was empty one block before creation and retained clone hash 0x7d417731f263b0c07af2af6b59a4f956d7ff46c07babf40087b5746154dbc202 through the incident. Its master was deployed earlier at block 17,622,995 in source-6 and retained the declared artifact hash. This cbETH/WETH clone is the first legacy-lineage execution context reached by the campaign, so its creation is the representative activation reset.

The 11 pool components are kept separate so lineage attribution remains machine-readable. Legacy master 0x05bb: cbETH/WETH 48.880994783447236415 WETH, wstETH/WETH 44.618985982526959274 WETH, rETH/WETH 5.151922446056045673 WETH, WETH/USDC 23,059.288839 USDC, sDAI/USDC 11,784.029677 USDC, WBTC/DAI 28,601.317832590344872652 DAI, and rETH/DAI 31,979.823008843540407093 DAI; exact USD subtotal 338,821.76619691822682552330043072. Newer master 0x4b3b: sUSDe/DAI 161,183.378480172531808886 DAI, mwstETH/wstETH 34.841843097892057306 wstETH, syrupUSDC/USDC 114,340.133355 USDC, and sDAI/USDC 14,244.041987 USDC; exact USD subtotal 395,283.24861868069118902436312289563392853470902444. Their exact sum is 734,105.01481559891801454766355361563392853470902444 USD. Archive balances reproduce every component. Campaign-created collateral positions and the small retained cbETH, wstETH, rETH, WBTC, sDAI, sUSDe, mwstETH-share and syrupUSDC quantities are attacker-supplied consideration, not additional victim loss. The cbETH continuation returned 0.026228701460587952 WETH to its pool and removed the remaining 0.000204277342017555 cbETH, so that return is netted from the earlier WETH outflow. The later syrup recurrence deposited 27,661.722202 USDC and withdrew 51,672.758035 USDC for 24,011.035833 USDC additional loss. Two unrelated transactions inside bounded archive windows withdrew 0.510962 USDC from the legacy sDAI pool and 2.478109933470371768 DAI from the WBTC pool; both are source-9 and excluded. No Ajna-pool return appears in the three campaign EOAs' later successful transactions through block 25,875,486. Stablecoins are at par. WETH prices are the closest preceding Chainlink ETH/USD answers for the three legacy WETH components. The new wstETH component uses the preceding 2,436.91552334 USD ETH answer and the pool-prestate wstETH stEthPerToken value 1.242726238226704561, yielding 3,028.41886119657925883287995374 USD per wstETH.

The campaign also hit the newer Ajna master lineage 0x4b3b9a972a884e37fd675ee57f6998da0be47e26 (runtime hash 0x0294b5b2dc7252ee040db2b47ce53de17d62a248a3f1644ff75e41a9dfd0fbda) through the same liquidation-accounting failure, first in the sUSDe/DAI clone 0x34bc3d3d274a355f3404c5dee2a96335540234de in source-2, 24,828 seconds after the anchor. That clone was created in source-7 at block 19262526 and its master deployed in source-8; its loss is included in the components. It is not a target because the anchor transaction did not execute it, and it would not supply the knot in any case.
